# DB\_CONN\_STR variable

`DB_CONN_STR` from the environment, read once when this module loads.

**Signature:**

```typescript
DB_CONN_STR: string | undefined
```

## Remarks

The fallback [database()](/api/sequelize/latest/sequelize.database/) uses when [IMQORMOptions.connectionString](/api/sequelize/latest/sequelize.imqormoptions.connectionstring/) is absent. Because it is captured at import time, changing `process.env` later has no effect on it.
